item.label: Source
item.description: Which course or trainer this shows. Left empty it follows the page, which is what a theme builder template wants.

item.label: Show a heading
item.description: Whether the field prints its name above or beside the value.

item.label: Heading
item.description: What to call this field. Empty means the name it comes with.

item.label: Heading element
item.description: Which HTML element the heading is.

item.label: Value element
item.description: Which HTML element the value is.

item.label: Arrangement
item.description: Heading above the value, or beside it.

item.label: After the heading
item.description: A colon, a dash — printed right after the heading.

item.label: Gap
item.description: Between the heading and the value.

item.label: Who the course is for
item.description: Left alone, everybody. A course whose name says nothing about this is never shown by a setting that asks.

item.label: Age from
item.description: Leaves out courses that finish below this age. Empty means no floor.

item.label: Age to
item.description: Leaves out courses that start above this age. Empty means no ceiling.

item.label: Order by
item.description: Left alone, the order the courses are filed in.

item.label: At most
item.description: How many rows to print. Empty or zero means all of them.

item.label: When there is nothing to show
item.description: Left empty the module disappears rather than printing a heading over a blank space.
